title: What 10x wagering means: the UK bonus cap in pounds

scenes.say: Since January twenty twenty-six, a site licensed in Great Britain can't ask you to bet a bonus more than ten times before you withdraw. Here's what that means in pounds.
scenes.caption: Since January 2026, a site licensed in Great Britain can't ask you to bet a bonus more than 10 times before you withdraw. Here's what that means in pounds.

visual.kicker: The UK wagering cap · since 19 January 2026
visual.title: What 10x means in pounds

scenes.say: The cap is measured against the bonus, not your deposit. A twenty-pound bonus can need at most two hundred pounds of bets.
scenes.caption: The cap is measured against the bonus, not your deposit. A £20 bonus can need at most £200 of bets.

scenes.say: Every bet costs something on average. On a slot that returns ninety-six per cent, each hundred pounds you bet costs four pounds on average. Clearing that bonus at ten times costs about eight pounds, so on average the bonus is worth about twelve.
scenes.caption: Every bet costs something on average. On a slot that returns 96%, each £100 you bet costs £4 on average. Clearing that bonus at 10x costs about £8, so on average the bonus is worth about £12.

scenes.say: Before the cap, thirty-five times was common. That's seven hundred pounds of bets, costing about twenty-eight. The bonus was worth less than nothing: minus eight pounds, on average.
scenes.caption: Before the cap, 35x was common. That's £700 of bets, costing about £28. The bonus was worth less than nothing: −£8, on average.

scenes.say: Game weighting still matters. If roulette counts thirty per cent of each stake, clearing the same bonus takes about six hundred and sixty-seven pounds of bets, not two hundred.
scenes.caption: Game weighting still matters. If roulette counts 30% of each stake, clearing the same bonus takes about £667 of bets, not £200.

scenes.say: The cap doesn't change time limits, maximum bet rules or caps on winnings, so check those in the terms. And these are averages: over a few hundred pounds of spins, your own result can be much better or much worse.
